en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a street of ornate villas and townhouses with eclectic architecture. Bilingual caption at front left reads 'Brassó / Kronstadt' and at bottom right 'Fellegvár sor a Beer villával / Schlossberg-Zeile mit Villa Beer'. The reverse has 'Levelezö-lap', a Hungarian 10 fillér stamp, Brasso postmarks dated July 1907, a German handwritten message, and an address to Bucharest.
